Elias tucked the note into his wool coat pocket, already planning a trip to the post office after his evening shift, his quiet routine suddenly brightened by the tiny, time-worn miracle.","w02":"凌晨四点的城市还浸在墨色的薄雾里，沿街的路灯拖着暖黄的光尾，把空无一人的柏油路染成柔和的蜜色。24小时便利店的玻璃门透出冷白的灯光，值班店员趴在柜台上打盹，玻璃柜里的三角饭团整齐排列。偶尔有晚归的代驾骑着电动车掠过，留下一串轻响，远处环卫工的橙黄色马甲在暗里晃过，扫帚划过地面的沙沙声，是这座沉睡城市里最早的呼吸。","w03":"- Recursion is when a problem solves itself by breaking into smaller, identical versions of the same problem.\n- It always has a base case: a simple problem with a direct answer, so it never loops forever.\n- For example, to count blocks in a stack, count 1 plus the count of the shorter stack, until you have zero blocks left."}
